json_schema.description: The human sits ABOVE the system: an agent asks, and the contract stays open until the human answers. Deliberately a separate type from ask_questions rather than a recipient=user special case, because the two differ in the one property that matters operationally — the sweeper must NEVER poke this one. A human is not a stalled agent, and a poke cap would eventually quarantine a question that was merely not answered yet. The sweeper's candidate set is goal_opened only, so today that holds by construction rather than by an exclusion list; anything that widens that set owes an explicit exclusion here. NOT spillable (contract event).
